description.zh:
◆ 身为君主时，势力采用默认策略【大汉皇叔】


◆ 个人被俘概率降低


◆ 在军团战中统领的小队的防御力增加15%


◆ 获得策略【人才选拔[改]】

◆ 自身外交能力增加10%
description.en:
◆ As Ruler, faction adopts default Strategy 【Imperial Uncle of Han】





◆ Reduced personal capture chance





◆ +15% Defense for commanded squads in Legion Battles





◆ Gain Strategy 【Talent Selection [Revised]】



◆ +10% personal Diplomacy Ability

description.zh: 执行治安和巡访时效率提升15%。
description.en: Order and Outreach efficiency increased by 15%.

description.zh: 登用成功率和在野武将投奔概率提高36%。
description.en: Recruitment Success Rate and Free Officer joining Chance increased by 36%.

description.zh: 每个月每座城市的民心提升20点。
description.en: Popularity in every city increases by 20 per month.

description2.zh: 瞬间恢复自己和50米范围内所有友方部队30%伤兵，增加士气20点，防御力上升20%。
description2.en: Instantly recovers 30% wounded troops for self and all allies within 50m, increasing Morale by 20 and Defense by 20%.

description2.zh: 自身速度和防御力提高40%，攻击力降低40%。
description2.en: Increases own Speed and Defense by 40% but reduces Attack by 40%.

description2.zh: 长剑绝学之一，以不可琢磨的身法连斩敌人，使用后有四成概率闪避下一次攻击。
description2.en: A sword art that repeatedly slashes enemies with unpredictable footwork. Upon use, grants a 40% chance to evade the next attack.

description2.zh: 以寒冰真气对敌人造成三连击。
description2.en: Deal a three-hit combo to the enemy with frost Qi.

description2.zh: 红炎斩的进阶招式，可造成更高伤害。
description2.en: An advanced Crimson Flame Slash dealing even more damage.

description2.zh: 回避牌，使用时将损失自身50点形势值。
description2.en: Evade Card. On use, lose 50 Momentum.

description2.zh: 为自身或队友恢复2.2倍攻击的形势值，随后每回合开始时恢复0.5倍攻击的形势值，持续2回合。
description2.en: Restores 2.2x Attack as Momentum for yourself or a teammate, then restores 0.5x Attack at the start of each turn for 2 turns.

description2.zh: 当士气不足100时, 每秒恢复2点士气
description2.en: When Morale is below 100, restores 2 Morale per second

description2.zh: 被敌人俘虏的概率降低100%
description2.en: Chance of being captured by enemies reduced by 100%

description2.zh: 回合结束对周围3米范围内的友军和自身消除一个不良状态并恢复5%生命和真气。
description2.en: At turn end, remove 1 debuff and restore 5% HP and Qi for self and allies within 3m.

description2.zh: 每次使用回避牌时，使攻击方获得1层【德】(可叠3层，持续永久)，当目标拥有3层【德】时，失去所有的【德】并获得【无颜】状态（持续两回合，每回合开始时失去80点形势值，若我方不止刘备一人，则出牌时无法选择刘备）。
description2.en: Each time an Evade Card is used, the attacker gains 1 stack of 【Virtue】 (stacks up to 3 times, permanent). When the target has 3 stacks of 【Virtue】, they lose all 【Virtue】 and gain 【Ashamed】 status (lasts 2 turns, losing 80 Momentum at the start of each turn, if our side has more than just Liu Bei, Liu Bei cannot be chosen when playing cards).

description.zh: 雌雄双股剑之一， 季汉昭烈帝刘备之兵器。刘备举兵时命良匠以镔铁铸双剑，雌雄各一，雄剑长三尺九寸，雌剑长三尺六寸。明代《阵纪》所载：“卞庄子之纷击法，王聚之起落法，刘先主之顾应法，马明王之闪电法，马超之出手法，五家之剑有传。”
description.en: One of the Twin Swords, the weapon of Liu Bei, Emperor Zhaolie of Shu-Han. When raising his banner, Liu Bei ordered master craftsmen to forge twin swords from fine steel, one male and one female. The male sword was three chi nine cun long, and the female sword three chi six cun. As recorded in the Ming dynasty's ‘Records of Formations’: ‘The flurry strikes of Bian Zhuangzi, the rising and falling technique of Wang Ju, the guarding and responding technique of Former Sovereign Liu, the lightning technique of Ma Mingwang, and the drawing technique of Ma Chao—the swordsmanship of these five masters has been passed down.’

description.zh: 覆盖龙纹饰罩袍的布衣，据说此袍为所有者亲自制作。
description.en: A cloth garment draped with a dragon-patterned surcoat, said to have been made by its owner.

description.zh: 配有独特玉石的巧士冠，多为当权之人所赐。
description.en: A Qiaoshi cap adorned with unique jade, typically bestowed by those in power.

description.zh: 战场上必不可少的身影。
description.en: An indispensable presence on the battlefield.

description.zh: 雌雄双股剑之一， 季汉昭烈帝刘备之兵器。刘备举兵时命良匠以镔铁铸双剑，雌雄各一，雄剑长三尺九寸，雌剑长三尺六寸。明代《阵纪》所载：“卞庄子之纷击法，王聚之起落法，刘先主之顾应法，马明王之闪电法，马超之出手法，五家之剑有传。”
description.en: One of the Twin Swords, the weapon of Emperor Zhaolie of Shu Han, Liu Bei. When raising his banner, Liu Bei ordered master smiths to forge twin swords from refined iron, one male and one female. The male sword was three feet nine inches long, and the female sword three feet six inches long. As recorded in the Ming dynasty's ‘Zhen Ji’: ‘The flurry strikes of Bian Zhuangzi, the rise-and-fall method of Wang Ju, the look-and-respond method of Former Sovereign Liu, the lightning method of Ma Mingwang, and the striking method of Ma Chao—the sword techniques of these five schools have been passed down.’

name.en: The Liu clan of Zhuo Commandery

desc.zh: 帝尧之后，出自姬姓，汉景帝子中山靖王刘胜之后，涿郡宗室支脉。蜀汉皇族。刘备以汉室宗亲起于微末，三顾茅庐，夺荆入川，建立蜀汉，与魏吴鼎足而立，享国四十三载。
desc.en: Descended from Emperor Yao and originating from the Ji surname, they were a branch of the imperial clan in Zhuo Commandery tracing their lineage to Liu Sheng, Prince Jing of Zhongshan and son of Emperor Jing of Han. As the imperial house of Shu-Han, Liu Bei rose from humble origins as a scion of the Han dynasty. After making three visits to the thatched cottage, taking Jing Province, and entering Yi Province, he founded Shu-Han to stand in a tripartite balance with Wei and Wu, ruling for forty-three years.

name.en: Three Heroes of the Late Han

desc.zh:
知音相伴春风笑，桃映祭台志气豪。忠义同心共患难，丹心日月映山河。

亲历条件：【主角为男性】，【与刘备关系等级不足5级】，【若主角非刘备、关羽、张飞时，与刘备关系等级至少为2级】
desc.en:
True friends united as laughter warms the spring breeze, peach blossoms shade the altar where grand ambitions rise. Bound in loyalty and righteousness through shared trials, their steadfast hearts shine bright as the sun and moon across the realm.



Participation Condition: 【Protagonist is male】, 【Relationship level with Liu Bei is below Level 5】, 【If the protagonist is not Liu Bei, Guan Yu, or Zhang Fei, Relationship level with Liu Bei must be at least Level 2】

desc.zh:
知音相伴春风笑，桃映祭台志气豪。忠义同心共患难，丹心日月映山河。

亲历条件：【主角为男性】，【与刘备关系等级不足5级】，【若主角非刘备、关羽、张飞时，与刘备关系等级至少为2级】
desc.en:
True friends gathered as spring breezes smile, peach blossoms grace the altar of soaring ambition. United in loyalty through hardship and trial, devoted hearts mirror the sun and moon across the land.



Participation Conditions: 【Protagonist is male】, 【Relationship level with Liu Bei is below Level 5】, 【If protagonist is not Liu Bei, Guan Yu, or Zhang Fei, Relationship level with Liu Bei is at least Level 2】

desc.zh:
董卓
接任卢植之位后征讨黄巾军，却被打得一路败退，即将被起义军合围...

禁忌条件：主角为刘备、关羽、张飞时，或为董卓、张角势力武将时无法触发

亲历条件：【完成剧情<颍川之战>】、【董卓、张宝、刘备、关羽、张飞存活】且【与刘备关系等级至少为2级】
desc.en:
Dong Zhuo

After succeeding Lu Zhi to campaign against the Yellow Turbans, he was driven into a rout and is now on the verge of being encircled by the rebels...



Forbidden Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Liu Bei, Guan Yu, or Zhang Fei, or is an Officer of Dong Zhuo's or Zhang Jiao's Faction



Participation Requirement: 【Complete the plot event <Battle of Yingchuan>】, 【Dong Zhuo, Zhang Bao, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei are alive】 and 【Relationship level with Liu Bei is at least Level 2】

desc.zh:
忍辱行贿？或随翼德挥拳？为刘备得官道贺，却遇贪污行贿之事......

禁忌条件：主角为张让，段珪时无法触发。

亲历条件：【与刘备关系等级大于2级或作为刘备、关羽、张飞】
desc.en:
Endure the humiliation and offer a bribe? Or throw punches alongside Yide? Arriving to congratulate Liu Bei on his appointment, only to encounter corrupt extortion...



Forbidden Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Zhang Rang or Duan Gui.



Participation Requirement: 【Relationship level with Liu Bei is greater than Level 2, or play as Liu Bei, Guan Yu, or Zhang Fei】

desc.zh:
接纳了吕布的刘备万万没想到对方竟会趁下邳空虚而动手，无奈之下刘备只好采取谋士的建议向曹操求援...

触发条件：曹操、刘关张、吕布存活。下邳属吕布、小沛属刘备、许昌属曹操。吕布势力至少拥有5名武将。

亲历条件：【主角在吕布，曹操或刘备的麾下】

逆天改命：【<高顺属吕布势力><身属曹操势力或刘备势力><与高顺关系等级达到2级>使高顺存活并成为家将】，【<曹操或刘备势力><与刘备关系等级达到2级><貂蝉等女眷属吕布势力>使貂蝉，吕姬，以及其他吕布势力下的女眷加入家族】
desc.en:
Having sheltered Lu Bu, Liu Bei never imagined his guest would strike while Xiapi was left vulnerable. Left with no choice, Liu Bei follows his advisor's counsel and turns to Cao Cao for aid...



Trigger Condition: Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, and Lu Bu are alive. Xiapi belongs to Lu Bu, Xiaopei belongs to Liu Bei, and Xuchang belongs to Cao Cao. Lu Bu's Faction has at least 5 Officers.



Participation Conditions: 【Protagonist serves under Lu Bu, Cao Cao, or Liu Bei】



Defy Fate: 【<Gao Shun belongs to Lu Bu's Faction><Serve in Cao Cao's Faction or Liu Bei's Faction><Relationship level with Gao Shun reaches Level 2>Ensure Gao Shun survives and recruit him as a Retainer】, 【<Cao Cao or Liu Bei's Faction><Relationship level with Liu Bei reaches Level 2><Diaochan and other female kin belong to Lu Bu's Faction>Have Diaochan, Lu Ji, and other female kin in Lu Bu's Faction join your Family】

desc.zh:
曹军突然压境，据守新野的刘备能否再一次化险为夷？

禁忌条件：主角是曹操、徐庶、诸葛亮、庞统、司马徽时无法触发。

亲历条件：【身属刘备势力】，【刘关张、赵云、徐庶、曹操存活】

逆天改命：【<与徐庶关系等级至少为2级且不为刘备>使徐庶成为家将】
desc.en:
Cao Cao's forces suddenly bear down on the border. Holding out in Xinye, can Liu Bei avert disaster once more?



Restricted Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Cao Cao, Xu Shu, Zhuge Liang, Pang Tong, or Sima Hui.



Participation Requirements: 【Belongs to Liu Bei's Faction】, 【Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Xu Shu, and Cao Cao are alive】



Defy Fate: 【<Relationship level with Xu Shu is at least Level 2 and protagonist is not Liu Bei> Recruit Xu Shu as Retainer】

name.en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage

desc.zh:
刘备听闻传说中的卧龙就在近郊，决定前往拜访，邀请卧龙出山。

主角禁忌：主角为诸葛亮，徐庶，司马徽，崔州平、刘备以外的君主时无法触发。

亲历条件：【与刘备关系等级至少为2级】，【刘备势力占据新野】，【关羽，张飞属刘备】

逆天改命：【使途中遇到的文士成为家将】
desc.en:
Hearing that the legendary Sleeping Dragon resides in the outskirts, Liu Bei resolves to visit and invite him to emerge from seclusion.



Protagonist Restrictions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Zhuge Liang, Xu Shu, Sima Hui, Cui Zhouping, or any Ruler other than Liu Bei.



Participation Requirements: 【Relationship level with Liu Bei is at least Level 2】, 【Liu Bei's Faction occupies Xinye】, 【Guan Yu and Zhang Fei belong to Liu Bei】



Defy Fate: 【Recruit the scholar encountered on the road as a Retainer】

desc.zh:
曹操即将向南方推进，刘备等人身处孤城，生死较量已迫在眉睫...

亲历条件：【身属刘备势力】，【刘关张、赵云、诸葛亮、曹操存活】，【新野属刘备，许昌属曹操】
desc.en:
Cao Cao prepares to advance toward the south. Trapped in an isolated city, Liu Bei and his companions face an imminent struggle for survival...



Participation Condition: 【Belong to Liu Bei's Faction】, 【Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, and Cao Cao are alive】, 【Xinye belongs to Liu Bei, and Xuchang belongs to Cao Cao】

desc.zh:
刘琮秘不发丧，将荆州拱手献给曹操，曹操命虎豹骑星夜疾驰围堵新野的刘备...

触发条件：曹操、刘关张、赵云、诸葛亮、甘梅、糜贞存活。襄阳属曹操，新野、江夏属刘备。

禁忌条件：主角是甘梅、糜贞时无法触发。

亲历条件：【身属刘备势力】

逆天改命：【<刘备势力><与糜贞关系等级达到3级>使糜贞存活并使其成为恋人并加入家族】
desc.en:
Liu Cong concealed his father's death and surrendered Jing Province to Cao Cao. Cao Cao then ordered the Tiger Cavalry to ride through the night to encircle Liu Bei at Xinye...



Trigger Condition: Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, Gan Mei, and Mi Zhen are alive. Xiangyang belongs to Cao Cao, Xinye and Jiangxia belong to Liu Bei.



Restriction: Cannot be triggered if the protagonist is Gan Mei or Mi Zhen.



Participation Requirement: 【Belong to Liu Bei's Faction】



Defy Fate: 【<Liu Bei Faction><Relationship level with Mi Zhen reaches Level 3> Ensure Mi Zhen survives, make her your Beloved, and have her join your Family】

desc.zh:
曹操百万大军兵临江东，于赤壁港口搭建水寨并日夜操练，刘备听从谋士的建议与孙权联手抗曹...

触发条件：曹操、刘关张、赵云，诸葛亮、孙权、周瑜存活。襄阳、新野属曹操，江夏属刘备，柴桑、建业属孙权。

禁忌条件：主角是庞统时无法触发。

人数条件：刘备势力至少需要2名额外文武官，孙权势力至少需要3名额外文官，曹操势力至少需要6名额外武官

亲历条件：【身属刘备或孙权势力】
desc.en:
With an army of a million men bearing down on Jiangdong, Cao Cao constructed a naval fortress at the port of Chibi and drilled his forces day and night. Liu Bei followed his strategist's advice and joined forces with Sun Quan to resist Cao Cao...



Trigger Condition: Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, Sun Quan, and Zhou Yu are alive. Xiangyang and Xinye belong to Cao Cao, Jiangxia belongs to Liu Bei, Chaisang and Jianye belong to Sun Quan.



Ineligible Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Pang Tong.



Personnel Condition: Liu Bei's Faction requires at least 2 additional Scholars or Warriors, Sun Quan's Faction requires at least 3 additional Scholars, and Cao Cao's Faction requires at least 6 additional Warriors



Participation Requirement: 【Belong to Liu Bei or Sun Quan's Faction】

desc.zh:
曹操百万大军兵临江东，于赤壁港口搭建水寨并日夜操练，刘备听从谋士的建议与孙权联手抗曹...

触发条件：曹操、刘关张、赵云，诸葛亮、孙权、周瑜存活。襄阳、新野属曹操，江夏属刘备，柴桑、建业属孙权。

禁忌条件：主角是庞统时无法触发。

人数条件：刘备势力至少需要2名额外文武官，孙权势力至少需要3名额外文官，曹操势力至少需要6名额外武官

亲历条件：【身属曹操势力】

逆天改命：【<曹操势力>占领江夏和柴桑】
desc.en:
Cao Cao's army of one million bore down on Jiangdong, constructing a naval fortress at the port of Chibi and drilling day and night. Heeding the counsel of his strategists, Liu Bei allied with Sun Quan to resist Cao Cao...



Trigger Condition: Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, Sun Quan, and Zhou Yu are alive. Xiangyang and Xinye belong to Cao Cao, Jiangxia belongs to Liu Bei, and Chaisang and Jianye belong to Sun Quan.



Exclusion Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Pang Tong.



Personnel Requirement: Liu Bei's Faction requires at least 2 additional Scholars or Warriors, Sun Quan's Faction requires at least 3 additional Scholars, Cao Cao's Faction requires at least 6 additional Warriors



Participation Condition: 【Affiliated with Cao Cao's Faction】



Defy Fate: 【<Cao Cao's Faction> Occupy Jiangxia and Chaisang】

desc.zh:
荆州初定根基未稳，刘备军决意征伐荆南四郡，以拓展疆土、稳固势力，一场席卷南部的征战即将拉开帷幕。

触发条件：江陵属刘备，零陵属刘度，桂阳属赵范，武陵属金旋，长沙属韩玄；诸葛亮、赵云、关羽、张飞、邢道荣、黄忠、魏延存活且属正确势力；马良、存活且属刘备势力或在野

禁忌条件：主角为马良、马谡、刘琦、刘度、邢道荣、刘贤、赵范、陈应、鲍隆、樊氏、金旋、巩志、韩玄、黄忠、魏延、刘磐时无法触发剧情

亲历条件：【身属刘备势力】

逆天改命：【<不为关羽>救下邢道荣并收为家将】，【<不为刘备、诸葛亮、关羽、张飞>救下陈应、鲍隆并收为家将】，【<不为刘备、诸葛亮、关羽、张飞、赵云>迎娶樊氏】，【<不为刘备、诸葛亮、关羽、赵云>救下金旋并收为家将】，【<不为刘备、诸葛亮、张飞、赵云>救下韩玄并收为家将】
desc.en:
Though Jing Province has newly settled, its foundations remain precarious. Liu Bei's forces resolve to conquer the Four Commanderies of South Jing to expand their territory and consolidate their faction, heralding a campaign that will sweep across the south.



Trigger Condition: Jiangling belongs to Liu Bei, Lingling belongs to Liu Du, Guiyang belongs to Zhao Fan, Wuling belongs to Jin Xuan, Changsha belongs to Han Xuan, Zhuge Liang, Zhao Yun, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Xing Daorong, Huang Zhong, and Wei Yan are alive and belong to the correct factions, Ma Liang is alive and belongs to Liu Bei's faction or is Free



Exclusion Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Ma Liang, Ma Su, Liu Qi, Liu Du, Xing Daorong, Liu Xian, Zhao Fan, Chen Ying, Bao Long, Lady Fan, Jin Xuan, Gong Zhi, Han Xuan, Huang Zhong, Wei Yan, or Liu Pan



Participation Condition: 【Belong to Liu Bei's faction】



Defy Fate: 【<Not Guan Yu> Rescue Xing Daorong and recruit as Retainer】, 【<Not Liu Bei, Zhuge Liang, Guan Yu, or Zhang Fei> Rescue Chen Ying and Bao Long and recruit as Retainers】, 【<Not Liu Bei, Zhuge Liang, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, or Zhao Yun> Marry Lady Fan】, 【<Not Liu Bei, Zhuge Liang, Guan Yu, or Zhao Yun> Rescue Jin Xuan and recruit as Retainer】, 【<Not Liu Bei, Zhuge Liang, Zhang Fei, or Zhao Yun> Rescue Han Xuan and recruit as Retainer】

desc.zh:
荆州已平定大半，刘备继续采用诸葛亮的建议，向益州靠拢。

触发条件：刘备、关羽、张飞、赵云、诸葛亮、刘璋、张鲁、马超存活。 江夏、江陵属刘备，成都、梓潼、巴郡属刘璋，马超属张鲁。

亲历条件：【身属刘备、刘璋或张鲁势力】

逆天改命：【<刘备势力><非前半部分留守后方的武将>救下庞统，<与张任关系等级至少为2>使张任存活并使其成为家将】
desc.en:
With most of Jing Province pacified, Liu Bei continues to follow Zhuge Liang's counsel, turning his ambitions toward Yi Province.



Trigger Condition: Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, Liu Zhang, Zhang Lu, and Ma Chao are alive. Jiangxia and Jiangling belong to Liu Bei, Chengdu, Zitong, and Ba Commandery belong to Liu Zhang, Ma Chao belongs to Zhang Lu.



Participation Condition: 【Belong to the Faction of Liu Bei, Liu Zhang, or Zhang Lu】



Defy Fate: 【<Liu Bei's Faction><Officer not stationed in the Rear during the first half> Rescue Pang Tong, <Relationship level with Zhang Ren is at least Level 2> Ensure Zhang Ren survives and recruit him as a Retainer】

desc.zh:
西川已平，荆州问题再度被推到风口浪尖，前往江陵商讨对策。

触发条件： 江陵、江夏、武陵、长沙、桂阳、零陵属刘备。孙权势力至少有5名武将。

亲历条件：【与关羽关系等级至少为2级】，【不为孙权势力武将】，【不为刘备、诸葛亮】
desc.en:
With Xichuan pacified, the dispute over Jing Province once again surges to the forefront. Head to Jiangling to deliberate on a strategy.



Trigger Condition: Jiangling, Jiangxia, Wuling, Changsha, Guiyang, and Lingling belong to Liu Bei. Sun Quan's Faction has at least 5 Officers.



Participation Condition: 【Relationship level with Guan Yu is at least Level 2】, 【Not an Officer of Sun Quan's Faction】, 【Not Liu Bei or Zhuge Liang】

desc.zh:
夺得汉中的曹操开始靠近益州边界寻找图取的机会，刘备听从众谋士的建议决定主动出击...

触发条件：刘备、张飞、诸葛亮、曹操存活。长安、汉中属曹操，成都属刘备。

禁忌条件：主角是王平时无法触发。

亲历条件：【身属刘备或曹操势力】

逆天改命：【<曹操势力>救下夏侯渊】
desc.en:
Having seized Hanzhong, Cao Cao draws near the borders of Yi Province in search of an opportunity to strike. Listening to the counsel of his advisors, Liu Bei resolves to take the initiative and attack...



Trigger Condition: Liu Bei, Zhang Fei, Zhuge Liang, and Cao Cao are alive. Changan and Hanzhong belong to Cao Cao, Chengdu belongs to Liu Bei.



Exclusion Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Wang Ping.



Participation Condition: 【Affiliated with Liu Bei's or Cao Cao's Faction】



Defy Fate: 【<Cao Cao's Faction> Rescue Xiahou Yuan】

desc.zh:
刘备势力鼎盛，而曹军在汉中战事不利，局势动荡。关羽北上襄樊，意欲扩大战果...

触发条件：刘关张、关平、曹操、曹仁、孙权存活。成都、汉中属刘备，襄阳属曹操，江夏属孙权。孙权势力至少有5名武将。

禁忌条件：主角是糜芳、傅士仁时无法触发。

亲历条件：【身属刘备或曹操势力】

逆天改命：【<刘备势力><与庞德关系等级至少为2级>收庞德为家将】
desc.en:
Liu Bei's Faction is at the height of its power, while Cao Cao's forces suffer setbacks in Hanzhong, leaving the realm in turmoil. Guan Yu marches north against Xiangfan, seeking to expand his victories...



Trigger Condition: Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Guan Ping, Cao Cao, Cao Ren, and Sun Quan are alive. Chengdu and Hanzhong belong to Liu Bei, Xiangyang belongs to Cao Cao, and Jiangxia belongs to Sun Quan. Sun Quan's Faction has at least 5 Officers.



Restricted Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Mi Fang or Fu Shiren.



Participation Condition: 【Belong to Liu Bei's or Cao Cao's Faction】



Defy Fate: 【<Liu Bei's Faction><Relationship level with Pang De is at least Level 2> Recruit Pang De as a Retainer】

desc.zh:
为报兄弟之仇，刘备不顾众文武的反对，倾全国兵力向东开拨，一场大战在所难免。

触发条件：刘备、张飞、诸葛亮、赵云、孙权、陆逊存活，关羽死亡。刘备势力至少10人，孙权势力至少8人。成都、汉中属刘备，江陵属孙权。

禁忌条件：主角是范疆、张达时无法触发。

亲历条件：【身属刘备或孙权势力】

逆天改命：【<刘备势力>战胜吴军！】
desc.en:
To avenge his sworn brother, Liu Bei ignores the opposition of his civil and military officials, mobilizing all of his realm's troops to march east. A great war is now inevitable.



Trigger Condition: Liu Bei, Zhang Fei, Zhuge Liang, Zhao Yun, Sun Quan, and Lu Xun are alive, Guan Yu is dead. Liu Bei's Faction has at least 10 members, and Sun Quan's Faction has at least 8 members. Chengdu and Hanzhong belong to Liu Bei, and Jiangling belongs to Sun Quan.



Incompatible Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Fan Jiang or Zhang Da.



Participation Requirements: 【Belong to Liu Bei's or Sun Quan's Faction】



Defy Fate: 【<Liu Bei's Faction> defeats the Wu forces!】

desc.zh:
刘表忧心立储之事，刘备劝其莫要废长立幼，蔡氏窃听到此言，心生怨恨，与蔡瑁商议在襄阳设局除掉刘备。

触发条件： 襄阳属刘表、新野属刘备。蔡氏在刘表麾下

禁忌条件：主角为刘备、刘表、蔡氏时无法触发

亲历条件：【与刘备关系等级至少为2级】，【不为刘表势力武将】
desc.en:
Liu Biao is troubled over the succession. Liu Bei advises him against passing over the elder son for the younger. Overhearing this, Lady Cai harbors resentment and plots with Cai Mao to lay a trap in Xiangyang to eliminate Liu Bei.



Trigger Condition: Xiangyang belongs to Liu Biao, Xinye belongs to Liu Bei. Lady Cai is under Liu Biao's command



Ineligible Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Liu Bei, Liu Biao, or Lady Cai



Participation Condition: 【Relationship level with Liu Bei is at least Level 2】, 【Not an Officer of Liu Biao's Faction】

desc.zh:
枭姬困于蜀地，满腹心事无人可诉。若能寻得可信之人依靠，或许便有转机，踏上归乡之路。

禁忌条件：主角为孙尚香，刘备，关羽，张飞，赵云，诸葛亮，孙权，吴国太，周善时无法触发。

亲历条件：【与孙尚香关系等级大于2级且不足5级】、【与刘备关系等级不到5级】，【孙尚香已婚】

逆天改命：【使孙尚香成为家将，可导致阿斗死亡】
desc.en:
Trapped in the land of Shu, the Fierce Lady has no one to confide in. If she can find a trustworthy soul to rely upon, fortune may turn, and the road back home may open.



Forbidden Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Sun Shangxiang, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, Sun Quan, Wu Guotai, or Zhou Shan.



Participation Conditions: 【Relationship level with Sun Shangxiang is above Level 2 and less than Level 5】, 【Relationship level with Liu Bei is less than Level 5】, 【Sun Shangxiang is married】



Defy Fate: 【Recruit Sun Shangxiang as a Retainer, may cause Ah Dou's death】

name.en: Taishi Ci Serves and Changes Allegiance
Zhang Ying Serves and Changes Allegiance

desc.zh:
刘备驾崩后，南中耆帅雍闿煽动高定、朱褒叛乱，占越雟、牂牁二郡。雍闿又联络南中诸部，占建宁，意欲通吴拒蜀。

触发条件：刘备死亡。诸葛亮、魏延、赵云、王平、马岱、马谡存活且在刘禅麾下，雍闿存活且在孟获麾下。成都、永昌属刘禅，越巂属高定，牂牁属朱褒，建宁属孟获。

亲历条件：【身属刘禅、孟获或高定势力】
desc.en:
Following the death of Liu Bei, Yong Kai, a chieftain of Nanzhong, incited Gao Ding and Zhu Bao to rebel, seizing the commanderies of Yuesui and Zangke. Yong Kai also rallied various tribes of Nanzhong to occupy Jianning, intending to ally with Wu and resist Shu.



Trigger Condition: Liu Bei is dead. Zhuge Liang, Wei Yan, Zhao Yun, Wang Ping, Ma Dai, and Ma Su are alive and serve under Liu Shan, Yong Kai is alive and serves under Meng Huo. Chengdu and Yongchang belong to Liu Shan, Yuesui belongs to Gao Ding, Zangke belongs to Zhu Bao, Jianning belongs to Meng Huo.



Participation Condition: 【Affiliated with Liu Shan's, Meng Huo's, or Gao Ding's Faction】

biography.zh: 中山靖王刘胜后代，蜀汉开国皇帝。先主一生百折不挠，终不为下。因年少丧父，从小与母亲靠织卖草鞋为生。十五岁拜师卢植，与公孙瓒交好。后因黄巾起义，心系天下的刘备与关羽、张飞在桃园三结义，成为出生入死的兄弟，在平定黄巾军、讨伐董卓等战役中表现优异，开启了传奇的一生。早期屡遭败绩，寄人篱下，先后投靠过公孙瓒、陶谦、曹操、袁绍等诸侯势力，只能辗转各地。后三顾茅庐请诸葛亮出山，与孙权联手大败曹操于赤壁。其后以疾风怒涛之势夺荆南，进而进军益州。又在汉中击败宿敌曹操，在群臣的拥戴下称汉中王，势力达到顶峰。称帝后为二弟关羽报仇，不听诸葛亮的劝告急于进兵东吴，最终于夷陵惨败，蜀汉精锐尽失，不久便病逝于白帝城，将刘禅托孤于诸葛亮，谥号昭烈皇帝。
biography.tc: 中山靖王劉勝后代，蜀漢開國皇帝。先主一生百折不撓，終不為下。因年少喪父，從小與母親靠織賣草鞋為生。十五歲拜師盧植，與公孫瓚交好。后因黃巾起義，心系天下的劉備與關羽、張飛在桃園三結義，成為出生入死的兄弟，在平定黃巾軍、討伐董卓等戰役中表現優異，開啟了傳奇的一生。早期屢遭敗績，寄人籬下，先后投靠過公孫瓚、陶謙、曹操、袁紹等諸侯勢力，只能輾轉各地。后三顧茅廬請諸葛亮出山，與孫權聯手大敗曹操于赤壁。其后以疾風怒濤之勢奪荊南，進而進軍益州。又在漢中擊敗宿敵曹操，在群臣的擁戴下稱漢中王，勢力達到頂峰。稱帝后為二弟關羽報仇，不聽諸葛亮的勸告急于進兵東吳，最終于夷陵慘敗，蜀漢精銳盡失，不久便病逝于白帝城，將劉禪托孤于諸葛亮，謚號昭烈皇帝。
biography.en: A descendant of Liu Sheng, Prince Jing of Zhongshan, and the founding Emperor of Shu Han. The First Ruler was indomitable throughout his life, never willing to remain subordinate. Having lost his father young, he grew up weaving and selling straw sandals with his mother. At fifteen he studied under Lu Zhi and befriended Gongsun Zan. When the Yellow Turban Rebellion erupted, Liu Bei, devoted to saving the realm, swore the Oath of the Peach Garden with Guan Yu and Zhang Fei, becoming brothers bound through life and death. He distinguished himself in battles suppressing the Yellow Turbans and subjugating Dong Zhuo, beginning a legendary life. In his early years he suffered repeated defeats and lived under the roofs of others, seeking refuge with warlord factions such as Gongsun Zan, Tao Qian, Cao Cao, and Yuan Shao, drifting from place to place. After visiting Zhuge Liang's thatched cottage three times to secure his service, he allied with Sun Quan to defeat Cao Cao at Red Cliffs. He then swept through southern Jing Province and advanced into Yi Province. Vanquishing his nemesis Cao Cao at Hanzhong, he was acclaimed King of Hanzhong by his court, reaching the zenith of his power. After proclaiming himself Emperor, seeking to avenge his sworn brother Guan Yu, he ignored Zhuge Liang's counsel and rushed to march against Eastern Wu, only to suffer a disastrous defeat at Yiling that wiped out the Shu Han elite. Soon after, he fell gravely ill and died at Baidicheng, entrusting Liu Shan to Zhuge Liang. He was posthumously titled Emperor Zhaolie.
biography.jp: 中山靖王劉勝の末裔であり、蜀漢の初代皇帝。先主は生涯にわたり不撓不屈で、終生人に屈することはなかった。幼くして父を失い、幼少期より母とともに草靴を編んで売って生計を立てた。十五歳で盧植に師事し、公孫瓚と親交を結ぶ。後に黄巾の乱が起こると、天下を憂う劉備は関羽、張飛と桃園の誓いを結び、生死を共にする義兄弟となり、黄巾軍の平定や董卓討伐などの戦いで頭角を現し、波乱万丈な生涯の幕を開けた。初期は幾度も敗北を重ねて他人の軒下に身を寄せ、公孫瓚、陶謙、曹操、袁紹ら諸侯の勢力を転々とした。後に三顧の礼を尽くして諸葛亮を迎え入れ、孫権と結んで赤壁にて曹操を大いに破る。その後、怒涛の勢いで荊南を制覇し、さらに益州へと進軍した。また漢中にて宿敵・曹操を破り、群臣に推戴されて漢中王を名乗り、勢力は頂点に達した。皇帝即位後は二弟・関羽の仇を討つべく、諸葛亮の諫言を聞き入れず東呉への進兵を急ぎ、最終的に夷陵で大敗を喫して蜀漢の精鋭をことごとく失った。間もなく白帝城にて病没し、劉禅の後事を諸葛亮に託した。諡号は昭烈皇帝。
biography.kr: 중산정왕 유승의 후손이자 촉한의 개국 황제이다. 선주는 평생 백절불굴하여 끝내 남의 밑에 머물지 않았다. 어릴 적 아버지를 여의어 어머니와 함께 짚으로 신발을 짜서 팔며 생계를 꾸렸다. 15세에 노식을 스승으로 모시고 공손찬과 깊은 친분을 맺었다. 훗날 황건적의 난이 일어나자 천하를 걱정하던 유비는 관우, 장비와 도원결의를 맺어 생사를 함께하는 의형제가 되었으며, 황건적 평정과 동탁 토벌 등 여러 전투에서 뛰어난 활약을 펼치며 전설적인 일생의 막을 올렸다. 초창기에는 거듭 패배를 겪고 남의 신세를 지며 공손찬, 도겸, 조조, 원소 등 여러 제후 세력에 차례로 몸을 의탁한 채 각지를 전전해야만 했다. 이후 삼고초려 끝에 제갈량을 모셔 오고 손권과 연합하여 적벽에서 조조를 대파했다. 그 뒤 질풍노도의 기세로 형남을 차지하고 나아가 익주로 진군했다. 또한 한중에서 숙적 조조를 격파하고 여러 신하의 추대를 받아 한중왕에 오르며 세력이 정점에 달했다. 칭제한 뒤에는 아우 관우의 원수를 갚고자 제갈량의 간언을 듣지 않고 성급히 동오로 진격했으나 결국 이릉에서 참패하여 촉한의 정예군을 모두 잃었다. 얼마 지나지 않아 백제성에서 병으로 서거하며 유선을 제갈량에게 탁고하였으니, 시호는 소열황제이다.

raw.descriptionJp: 中山靖王劉勝の末裔であり、蜀漢の初代皇帝。先主は生涯にわたり不撓不屈で、終生人に屈することはなかった。幼くして父を失い、幼少期より母とともに草靴を編んで売って生計を立てた。十五歳で盧植に師事し、公孫瓚と親交を結ぶ。後に黄巾の乱が起こると、天下を憂う劉備は関羽、張飛と桃園の誓いを結び、生死を共にする義兄弟となり、黄巾軍の平定や董卓討伐などの戦いで頭角を現し、波乱万丈な生涯の幕を開けた。初期は幾度も敗北を重ねて他人の軒下に身を寄せ、公孫瓚、陶謙、曹操、袁紹ら諸侯の勢力を転々とした。後に三顧の礼を尽くして諸葛亮を迎え入れ、孫権と結んで赤壁にて曹操を大いに破る。その後、怒涛の勢いで荊南を制覇し、さらに益州へと進軍した。また漢中にて宿敵・曹操を破り、群臣に推戴されて漢中王を名乗り、勢力は頂点に達した。皇帝即位後は二弟・関羽の仇を討つべく、諸葛亮の諫言を聞き入れず東呉への進兵を急ぎ、最終的に夷陵で大敗を喫して蜀漢の精鋭をことごとく失った。間もなく白帝城にて病没し、劉禅の後事を諸葛亮に託した。諡号は昭烈皇帝。
raw.descriptionKr: 중산정왕 유승의 후손이자 촉한의 개국 황제이다. 선주는 평생 백절불굴하여 끝내 남의 밑에 머물지 않았다. 어릴 적 아버지를 여의어 어머니와 함께 짚으로 신발을 짜서 팔며 생계를 꾸렸다. 15세에 노식을 스승으로 모시고 공손찬과 깊은 친분을 맺었다. 훗날 황건적의 난이 일어나자 천하를 걱정하던 유비는 관우, 장비와 도원결의를 맺어 생사를 함께하는 의형제가 되었으며, 황건적 평정과 동탁 토벌 등 여러 전투에서 뛰어난 활약을 펼치며 전설적인 일생의 막을 올렸다. 초창기에는 거듭 패배를 겪고 남의 신세를 지며 공손찬, 도겸, 조조, 원소 등 여러 제후 세력에 차례로 몸을 의탁한 채 각지를 전전해야만 했다. 이후 삼고초려 끝에 제갈량을 모셔 오고 손권과 연합하여 적벽에서 조조를 대파했다. 그 뒤 질풍노도의 기세로 형남을 차지하고 나아가 익주로 진군했다. 또한 한중에서 숙적 조조를 격파하고 여러 신하의 추대를 받아 한중왕에 오르며 세력이 정점에 달했다. 칭제한 뒤에는 아우 관우의 원수를 갚고자 제갈량의 간언을 듣지 않고 성급히 동오로 진격했으나 결국 이릉에서 참패하여 촉한의 정예군을 모두 잃었다. 얼마 지나지 않아 백제성에서 병으로 서거하며 유선을 제갈량에게 탁고하였으니, 시호는 소열황제이다.
